name: solve_linear_programming
description: Solve pure continuous Linear Programming (LP) problems. Use this when variables can be fractions (e.g., liters of water, kg of flour).

payload.description: Mathematical model definition containing 'sense' (MIN/MAX), 'objective' (dict), and 'constraints' (list of dicts with terms, op, rhs).

name: solve_mixed_integer_programming
description: Solve Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) using Branch and Bound. Use this when SOME or ALL variables MUST be integers (e.g., number of people, cars). You MUST declare integer variables in the 'integer_variables' array.

payload.description: Model containing 'sense', 'objective', 'constraints', and 'integer_variables' (array of strings for variables that must be whole numbers).

name: solve_pure_integer_programming
description: Solve Pure Integer Linear Programming (ILP) using Gomory Cutting Planes. Use this ONLY when ALL variables in the problem are strictly integers.

payload.description: Model containing 'sense', 'objective', and 'constraints'. No need to specify integer_variables as all are assumed integer.

name: solve_unweighted_bipartite_matching
description: Solve unweighted 1-to-1 matching (Assignment Problem) using the Hungarian algorithm. Use this to maximize the number of matches between two groups without considering profit/cost.

payload.description: Must contain 'edges', a list of dicts with 'u' (left node) and 'v' (right node).

name: solve_maximum_weight_matching
description: Solve maximum weight perfect bipartite matching using the Kuhn-Munkres (KM) algorithm. Use this to assign tasks to workers to maximize TOTAL PROFIT or EFFICIENCY.

payload.description: Must contain 'edges', a list of dicts with 'u' (left node), 'v' (right node), and 'w' (integer weight/profit).
